newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOVERNMENT TO EASE TAX FINE POLICY.
newsitem.headline: GOVERNMENT TO EASE TAX FINE POLICY.

text.p: The government intends to reduce fines on tax evadors to 10 percent from 25 percent of the company's annual turnover, Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said on Thursday.
"We are considering reducing the fine to 10 percent from 25 percent of the company's annual turnover but the campaign against tax evadors will continue," Vagnorius said.
The government launched a severe campaign against tax evadors a few months ago and it seems to have improved budget revenue collection.
The government said earlier that the tax inspection has checked around 7,500 companies and imposed around 13 million litas of fines, one of them as high as four million litas.
